Film Producer Discusses 'Hanuman Ansh' Box Office Survival

Producer Ragini Sona of the film 'Hanuman Ansh' stated that she did not believe the movie would survive its initial run, particularly when placed opposite another film referred to as 'Toxic'. Sona indicated that the film was nearly removed from theaters. She made these remarks regarding the box office success of 'Hanuman Ansh'.
